title: M5 stage 7: explicit binary additive-character counting kernel
scope: Section 2 binary coordinate character identities, without claiming quotient-coordinate identification or complete M5 counts

spec.name: M5.Character.bit_add
spec.statement: ∀ a b c : ZMod 2, M5.Character.bitSign a (b + c) = M5.Character.bitSign a b * M5.Character.bitSign a c
spec.guidance: Finite case split over a,b,c : ZMod 2 using fin_cases, then decide or norm_num after unfolding bitSign. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Character.bit_orthogonality
spec.statement: ∀ b : ZMod 2, (∑ a : ZMod 2, M5.Character.bitSign a b) = if b = 0 then 2 else 0
spec.guidance: Use fin_cases b; finite sum ZMod 2 can be reduced using decide or explicit evaluation; bitSign is computable. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Character.character_add
spec.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (λ z u : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), M5.Character.value λ (z + u) = M5.Character.value λ z * M5.Character.value λ u
spec.guidance: Unfold value, Pi addition; use accepted bit_add pointwise and Finset.prod_mul_distrib. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Character.character_orthogonality
spec.statement: ∀ (D : ℕ) (z : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), (∑ λ : M5.Character.BinaryVector D, M5.Character.value λ z) = if z = 0 then (2 : ℤ) ^ D else 0
spec.guidance: Unfold value. Reverse Fintype.prod_sum to factor the sum over all binary vectors as product over coordinates of local sums. Apply bit_orthogonality. If z=0 product is 2^D; otherwise some coordinate is nonzero and Finset.prod_eq_zero applies. D=0 must remain included. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.

spec.name: M5.Character.finite_fibre_count
spec.statement: ∀ (D n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → M5.Character.BinaryVector D) (z : M5.Character.BinaryVector D), (∑ λ : M5.Character.BinaryVector D, M5.Character.value λ z * ∑ u : Fin n, M5.Character.value λ (f u)) = (2 : ℤ) ^ D * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => f u = z)).card : ℤ)
spec.guidance: Distribute multiplication over inner sum, commute finite sums, reverse character_add and apply character_orthogonality to z+f u. In characteristic two z+f u=0 iff f u=z. Sum the resulting indicators as the filter cardinality. Use actual accepted ancestor lemmas; n=0 and D=0 are allowed. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve exact target.
